content: Yesus kovakato
Arono masyoto sambaya mewen ti ari Minggu ama awatan ngko dave akane ntipu, naije Maria Magdalena me, Maria kaijinta me yurija yo Yesus apa aipapo raen.
Kavuratawe mungkijo akoe inta ravari, weye naito Amisye inta no no munijo ntiti paje, umba de po oramo unsanda aipapo umawe raroyar umba seo tuna ama vone rai.
Naito Amisye umaso ba dave, maisyare ivake wemaisy, muno apa ansune mamo mpope dave.
Naito wo aipapo ramane umawe ujani dave ti ututar, umba mamune ngkaumudi ti utatayaje utavai no min, maisyare vatano ukakai to mansamaisy.
Umba naito Amisye umawe po raura nanto wanya umawe yai pare, “Vemo ijaniv inya. Syo raen ipo Yesus akani, Wepirati auseo sawa inyo kapite rai to.
Soamo norije ramu, yara kovakato to maisyare arono wusyinara Po raurave wemai to. Weti ide ipo Apa aipapo tami raije raeni so.

Weti ipavave ipakata ipo raura Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai ipare, ‘Soamo Yesus kovakato no wene rai to! Opamo puisya to no Galilea rai to. Ti wata no ratuije umba wapo aen.’ Syare isaemeno sya ana syo raura so rai.”
Wanya umaso yavave yo aipapo rapaya ti no. Onayamo ijani dave weramu yanayanambe rave tavon, weti yansanan yakare indamu yo raura Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije mai.
Kavuratawe Yesus nande wanya umaso yai, Po raura pare, “Awatane ngkovo isai.” Umba je yararaijo Ai, yo vukane ranteter no Amun muno yo ajoe raijar indamu ibeaje Ai.
Umba Yesus po raura nande yai pare, “Ijaniv inya, yara ipakata ipo raura Sya arakove mai inda wuruta no Galilea, umba wo inaen no ratuije.”
Syeno akokoe muno akarijo Yahudi wo doije raunanto naito wo aipapo ramane mai indamu wayao angkarive
Wanya umaso ija to, umba naito wo aipapo ramane umawe inta wakare no Yerusalem, wo anakotaro nande tenambe umaso raura syeno akokoe mansai.
Weti syeno akokoe nawe akarijo Yahudi nawe wanugan indamu wayao rai. Umba wo rapatimu ware wo doijo manui raunanto naite umawe mansai indamu vemo wo Yesus apa kovakatoe raura inya.
Weti wo raura naite umawe mai ware, “Reamare wapo raura no taiso wapare, ‘Ama namanoe Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije ude wo Yesus anasine ranaonoambe no arono reanaki.’
Ranivara Gubernur Pilatus po ana umaso ranaun ti parijo wasai pare wapo Apa aipapo raman kobe jewen, weamo indati reamo gubernur anuga raugabe indamu vemo po mangke raugaje wasai jinya.”
Weti naite umawe wo doijo uma wo raunandeowe raugav, umba ubeta awa ana wo matutiro raije rarijati. Weti wo ayao Yesus anasine ranaonoambeye umaso ravovo vatano Yahudi mansaija ndea unumeso.
Yesus po apa arakove matutir uta wo Ayao Kove ravovo no rui rui vayave
Weti Yesus apa arakovo abusyinara eane intabo utavondi aije wuruta no Galilea, umba usea unato uma Yesus po matutir uta raijoe rai.
Umba wo aen no ratuije, weti wo vukane ranteter no Amun muno ubeaje Ai, weramu inta nawamo manuga mamaundive Ai weye wanave kobe jewen.
Umba Yesus de pararaijo mai, Po raura nanto mai pare, “Injayo Amisye po vambunine raunande Rinai indamu ibe akarive no munijo ntiti muno mine vone so rai tenambe vintabo.

Maisyare omai ti, Syo wasatutir wata no rui rui vayave indamu wapo vatane kotaro ntuna no mine so rai mansanyao tenambe indamu utavondijo Rinai. Muno wapo maugasyo kuvuni mana raijo Injayo Amisye apa tame rai muno Apa Kavo tame rai muno Anawayo Vambunine ama tame rai.
Muno wapo manyao indamu ubeta Sya ananyao syo raugaje wasai to rai tenambe. Tugae rave, ituna wasautan tutira ntoa munije ama akari.”
